## Powered by vision AI

Built into every Scandit product and solution, the Scandit Vision AI Engine delivers unmatched speed, accuracy, and intelligence.

Empower customers and employees, simplify implementation, protect profit, and reduce operational risk. The Scandit Vision AI Engine:

- Automatically adapts the user interface based on live data inputs.
- Automates complex or repetitive tasks.
- Translates insights into prioritized actions.
- Reduces the need for extensive coding and design efforts to account for edge cases.

## Explore smart data capture products

![](https://assets.scandit.com/6875x4583/b4e238162b/matrixscan-pick-top-shelf.jpg/m/640x0/smart/filters:quality(80):format(jpeg))

### Barcode scanning

Barcode scanning that understands and adapts to context and user intent, delivering tailored interfaces and functionality needed at the right moment.

- Reduce unwanted scans by up to 100% with context-aware scanning.
- Decode any barcode, any condition, any environment.
- Optimize workflows with multiple barcode scanning, AR overlays, and simultaneous scanning of barcodes and text.

[Learn more](https://www.scandit.com/products/barcode-scanning/) [Demo apps](https://www.scandit.com/resources/demo-apps/)

![car rental scan drivers license mobile device](https://assets.scandit.com/1280x720/6ec1bcbe89/id-bolt-car-rental-scan-drivers-license.jpg/m/640x0/smart/filters:quality(80):format(jpeg))

### ID and passport scanning

Accurately capture ID data and detect fakes, while maintaining frictionless user experiences.

- Scan and verify IDs in just 1 second, with user-friendly scanning workflows.
- Scan all major document types with up to 100% scan accuracy rate.
- All data processing happens on-device, protecting PII customer data as well as your business.

[Learn more](https://www.scandit.com/products/id-scanning/) [Demo apps](https://www.scandit.com/resources/demo-apps/)

![shelf scanning mobile device alerts shelfview](https://assets.scandit.com/1280x720/d56e01a717/shelfview-alerts-featured-image.jpg/m/640x0/smart/filters:quality(80):format(jpeg))

### ShelfView

AI-powered shelf intelligence solution to maximize on-shelf availability and ensure price and planogram compliance.

- Capture data flexibly using smart devices, fixed cameras, or robots.
- Get 99.7% shelf insight accuracy.
- Notify associates with timely alerts to replenish shelves or update prices.

[Learn more](https://www.scandit.com/products/shelfview/)
